headline: Newell Brands (NWL) Stock Gets Fair Value Boost As Analysts Weigh Stabilising Demand
summary: Price targets for Newell Brands have been reset around a modestly higher fair value, with the central valuation reference point moving from US$4.94 to US$5.59 in the latest model. That shift sits within a broader analyst range of about US$3.50 to US$7, where more optimistic views highlight stabilising trends and cost control while cautious voices point to earnings and demand risks.
